thread:
Anita P: Quick sync — we need a play for voucher tranche onboarding for the SI go-live next month. Goal: allow partners to pre-provision discounted voucher pools customers can redeem, then convert to usage/commit after 60 days. Thoughts?

Marco G: sounds good. key questions: how is redemption metered? is it a pure credit or maps to reserved capacity?

Ellen S: From comms side — we need clear customer-facing language: "voucher" vs "prepaid credit" vs "trial credit". prefer "voucher" only if it maps to usage automatically.

Ravi K: technical constraint: marketplace metering only supports 'usage' or 'reservation' at offer attach. we can implement a redemption webhook that issues internal credit and tags usage for conversion. need to add partner_id + voucher_id tags.

Marco G: finance ok with 60 day conversion if we include clawback. will need a template.

Anita P: sketch of the flow:
- Partner preloads voucher tranche (T1)
- Customer redeems voucher -> creates internal credit with tags
- After 60d, auto-convert outstanding credit to commit or expire
- Conversion triggers invoice adjustment or reserved SKU uplift

Ravi K: sample mapping config:
```
voucher:
  sku: REDWOOD-HW-APPLIANCE-1
  tranche: T1
  discount: 20%
  redeem_window_days: 60
  billing_tags: [partner_id, voucher_id, hw_batch]
```

Ravi K: tentative CLI to map:
```
rw-marketplace map-voucher --id T1 --offer O-APPL-01 --redeem-window 60
```

Marco G: owners: Marco -> partner ops, Finance -> credit terms, Elena (legal) -> contract clause, Services/SI -> redemption integration

Ellen S: I'll draft a 2-slide partner play and 1-pager for customers. sending mockups by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Anita P: blockers? timeline: go-live target 2026-04-15, dry-run 2026-04-01

Ravi K: dev note — need API for 'list-vouchers?status=active' + webhook for 'voucher.redeemed'. I'll put a PR up tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Reminder — SI go-live checklist due in 3 days

Marco G: ack. I'll sync with Elena and Finance today. :handshake:

Ellen S: can someone share partner portal link where we show voucher inventory? need to add sku/docs. https://console.redwood.ai/partner/vouchers

Anita P: thanks all — next sync Tuesday 10am PT. @Ravi K please add tickets and link to this thread. :calendar:
